subject: A connected water system, pump cutaway, meter and illustrative data
styleLock: Same simple pastel cutaway, sage ground, cream supports, muted-blue housings, gold rotors and pale-blue water pipes.
motion: Same persistent scene geometry throughout; camera follows the connected pipe into the adjacent mechanism.
Axial dependency-ordered insertion and individual bolt seating before operation.
World-anchored data panels stay in place while the camera travels between them.
limits: Conceptual pump/meter assemblies; no OEM or calibration accuracy claim.
All chart values are illustrative and labeled as such.

shots.action: Establish the connected water system and launch the explanatory motion.
Stop the drive, unthread the bolts, then withdraw the cover axially and laterally.
Align the same cover laterally, seat it axially, tighten its bolts, then restart the pump.
Follow the connected outlet pipe into the adjacent meter assembly.
Seat bearing, rotor, gasket, bezel and individual bolts in dependency order.
Raise the camera from the operating meter to its world-anchored live counter.
Truck the actual camera to the stationary zero-baseline comparison panel.
Lift the camera through the same world to the recorded-flow panel.
Arc toward the share panel while preserving category identities and colors.
Widen the same continuous world to reveal the complete visual route.

cameraMethod: One world, a continuous timed 3D Hermite camera path, changing view angle and optical zoom; no canvas-slide handoffs.
